memo.argument: Heading 6105 covers 'Men's or boys' shirts, knitted or crocheted.' The product is a complete boys' T-shirt made of knitted jersey fabric with a crew neckline, short sleeves, and hemmed bottom—all hallmarks of a shirt under this heading. Chapter 61 note 1 confirms this chapter applies only to made-up knitted articles, which this product is. The product is classifiable under 6105.10 (of cotton) because cotton comprises 50% by weight. The best 10-digit code is 6105.10.00.30 (Other boys' shirts of cotton), which is the residual category for boys' cotton knit shirts not imported as parts of playsuits.
